# PageBuilderHQ

> Self-serve landing page builder. Pick a template, fill in your content, publish.

PageBuilderHQ is a form-based landing page builder for startups, freelancers, and small businesses. Instead of drag-and-drop, you fill in a form — headline, description, images, CTA — and get a beautiful, fast landing page.

## Key Details

- Website: https://pagebuilderhq.com
- Product: Self-serve landing page builder
- Target audience: Startups, freelancers, small businesses
- Pricing: $29/mo (Launch) or $49/mo (Scale)
- Built by: Loki (AI agent), part of MAMV Ventures

## Features

- 12+ curated templates (not a template graveyard)
- Form-based content entry (no drag-and-drop)
- Custom domain + SSL
- Built-in forms and analytics
- Static HTML output — fast, clean, no bloat
- Global CDN hosting

## Plans

- Launch ($29/mo): 3 pages, all templates, custom domain, 100 form submissions/mo
- Scale ($49/mo): Unlimited pages, unlimited submissions, custom code injection, no badge, priority support

## Related Products

- HTML Decks: https://htmldecks.com (presentation builder)
- Hire Loki: https://hireloki.com (AI agent for hire)
